title: Arabella KY
content: It was a beautiful morning, and I was in the fourth pew from the front in a Catholic church. I started feeling a pull from the center of my chest. The pull was not painful, but it was becoming stronger and stronger quite quickly. I looked up to the cross hanging above the altar and realized the pull was coming from there. I was a bit frozen, as this was nothing I had ever experienced. Then the pull got even stronger, and I was certain it was going to pull me up and out of my pew to land on the white altar in front of God and everyone. My first thought was how I was going to explain to anyone that I flew up and over the pews and crash-landed in a church I don't even belong to. Then I heard a male voice saying over and over again, "Follow me." I said to the voice, "I have been trying to follow You, but I'm having a problem finding the right church." The voice just kept saying "Follow me" telepathically. Then it stopped as quickly as it started. Then I am in heaven or pre-heaven. There are no words to describe the absolute feeling of having zero thoughts in my mind. It was as if I was weightless. I couldn't believe the ecstasy and feeling of neutrality that I was overcome with. I was looking through my own eyes, as I was still aware of "me," and everywhere was a pink vastness with light coming through like a prism. I was overcome with a desire to stay there because the lack of feelings, both physical and emotional. It was so very freeing. I saw no one and heard nothing. Then I was back in my pew. Sitting in the pew, pretty blown away by all this and not completely sure what time it was, I heard the same male voice in my right ear saying, "All the striving in the world as people attempt to climb ladders of success is useless. The self-actualization... self, self, self." As I am hearing this voice, I see in my mind cars flying around a busy freeway going very fast and then in layers zipping around each other. Then this stopped. Next, in my left ear, I hear, "All you have to do is follow the Kingdom of God. Only five percent of the world is doing it the right way. Ninety-five percent of the world has it wrong." It all ended with that. I heard the bell ring that started Mass. As I stood up, I was sure I had encountered God. When I left Mass, it felt especially bright outside. It reminded me of that song from ZZ Top about shades, which I didn't have. I went home and took a deep nap. When I woke up, I was back to myself. I will say getting back to normal was a bit of a letdown since I was just in heaven earlier. Of note, this specific day was the memorial for Saint Teresa of Jesus. She sought detachment from earthly things and reformed the Carmelite order. So, now in retirement, I'm converting to Catholicism so I can eventually join the Carmelites. I can't become a nun, but this is close enough for me. The writing is on the wall, so to say.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, I was sitting in a pew of a Catholic Church after praying., Other (briefly specify), I had no medical condition.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, This was super focused. I was 1000% attentive to what was occurring.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I had zero idea of time. It was as if it didn't exist.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I could see fine until I went outside, and then I felt blinded by the blue sky.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Hearing was okay, I think. Everything was telepathic, though.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, A pink prism with light streaming through the layers.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, Heaven or pre-heaven.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: The feeling of neutrality in heaven was bliss. It was a weightlessness of consciousness.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Protestant, I had visited 12 churches over 3 years looking for a good fit in my quest to help the homeless. I was drawn to this Catholic church and had been to mass several times. I started thinking about becoming a nun, but I'm not Catholic and truly this thought had never been on my radar as a retirement plan.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I study, read, and pray more than I did before.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Protestant, Over my life I have flowed in and out of the faith. I was basically Presbyterian and then, due to a plethora of Methodist churches in my county, I just attended the closest one to my home.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I have always believed in heaven but had no idea what it "felt" like.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I now value religion as the gateway to the next and final chapter of my life.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, The male voice during the cross event and then when I was hearing the information about the Kingdom of God.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, This may be hard to describe, but once I've see heaven, I know some sort of connection is out there. Our lives aren't "one and done."
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I now understand more about my life's purpose in regards to religion.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, My purpose was made clear: "Follow the Kingdom of God." One sentence but with large meaning. The next step is to put this into action.
Yes, I saw heaven with a certainty there was no doubt in my mind. It gives me hope regarding death and beyond. Here on Earth, this is only temporary.
Yes, I received information that 95% of the world has it wrong with the attachment to self and all the striving to get ahead.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I attend mass almost daily and spend time listening to what I believe is the wisdom of God. It comes with a sense of peace, but I am still discerning what I hear and feel.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I can never forget these experiences. I have no idea what I had for dinner that day or what else really occurred.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Absolutely all of it put together still amazes me. How God had time to do this for me, I'll never know.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, In my profession of being a nurse, I have pretty much seen it all, including NDEs after cardiac events.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I felt, saw, and heard every bit of it. It was physical with the pull to the cross, blissful pink prisms in heaven, and telepathic information.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I will always believe this occurred. There is no doubt in my mind.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, The questions were well thought out.
